items.name: Smokehouse Hunter's Jerky
items.effect: Thin strips of game meat, salted and smoked over green hardwood until they bend without breaking. A bundle counts as one day of rations and keeps for a full season even in damp packs.

recipe.lore: Every hunting lodge has a smoke-rack and an argument about which meat jerks best; the answer is always whatever you killed yesterday, cut thin and salted hard.

items.name: Titanroast Feast
items.effect: A slow-roasted haunch of a huge beast, glazed around the still-warm heart of a great charger or stag. Up to six creatures who share it within an hour gain 2 temporary hit points and advantage on the next saving throw they make against exhaustion within 8 hours.

recipe.lore: Frontier cooks swear the heart of an animal that ran until it dropped carries its stubbornness into the roast; the giant meat is simply there so everyone gets a slab.

items.name: Brinepot Chowder
items.effect: A thick fisherman's stew of whatever the nets and harpoons brought in. A bowl counts as a meal, and a diver who eats it warm has advantage on the next Constitution check to resist exhaustion from cold water that day.

recipe.lore: Tentacle meat is too tough to eat on its own, so harbour cooks boil it with shark and crab until the whole pot turns gluey and warming.

items.name: Bogman's Pepperpot
items.effect: A peppery marsh stew thick with reptile and amphibian meat. Eaters have advantage on saving throws against disease caught from swamp water for the next 8 hours, thanks to the fierce peppers more than the meat.

recipe.lore: Swamp folk learned long ago that anything scaly or slimy is safe to eat once it's drowned in pepper and vinegar, and that the same brew keeps bog-fever away.

items.name: Crawler's Protein Cake
items.effect: Dense, nutty-tasting cakes pressed from insect larvae and the pale meat of giant arthropods. One cake counts as a full day's food and weighs only a quarter pound.

recipe.lore: Underdark traders and desert caravans both prize bug-meal for its weight; honey binds the crumbly paste into cakes that survive a month in a saddlebag.

items.name: Frostmarch Pemmican
items.effect: Pounded dried meat mixed with rendered fat and berries into dense bricks. A creature that eats one each day has advantage on saving throws against exhaustion from extreme cold.

recipe.lore: Beasts that survive the tundra carry their warmth as fat; pound that fat into lean meat and a traveller carries a little of the beast's winter coat in their belly.

items.name: Warheart Oat-Mash
items.effect: A warm mash of oats and powdered heart fed to a mount before battle. For 8 hours the animal's walking speed increases by 10 feet and it has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

recipe.lore: Cavalry grooms dry the heart of a warhorse that died charging and grate a pinch into each feed; horses, they say, remember the courage of their own kind.

items.name: Bogstrider Boots
items.effect: Knee-high boots of scaled reptile hide sealed with pitch. They never let water in, and you have advantage on ability checks to keep your footing on mud, slick rock and wet logs.

recipe.lore: Crocodile hide sheds water the way the animal does, and the tiny ridges of its scales grip mud better than any hobnail.

items.name: Thickhide Hunting Armor
items.effect: Hide armor made from a single thick beast hide, boiled and shaped to the wearer. It counts as hide armor but weighs only 8 pounds and can be put on or taken off in 1 minute.

recipe.lore: Patchwork hide armour is heavy because of all the overlaps; a hide big enough to wrap a whole torso needs none, which is why hunters haul rhino and mammoth skins home whole.

items.name: Tundra Greatcoat
items.effect: A heavy knee-length coat of thick fur, hair side in. The wearer has advantage on saving throws against exhaustion caused by extreme cold.

recipe.lore: Anything that winters in the snow grows fur worth stealing; worn fur-inward the pelt keeps doing its first job.

items.name: Dunewalker Camel Wrap
items.effect: A loose robe and face-wrap woven from coarse camel hair over a camel-leather yoke. The wearer has advantage on saving throws against exhaustion from extreme heat and on saves against blinding sand.

recipe.lore: Camel hair breathes in the day and holds warmth at night, just as it does on the camel.

items.name: Packmaster's Saddlebags
items.effect: Paired leather saddlebags stiffened with hoof glue. They hold twice what ordinary saddlebags do without chafing the animal, and they float when empty.

recipe.lore: Draft-horse leather is thick enough to stand up on its own when boiled in hoof glue, so the bags keep their shape instead of sagging onto the animal's flanks.

items.name: Horsehair Snare Kit
items.effect: A roll of braided tail-hair nooses and hoof-glue triggers. You have advantage on checks to trap Small or smaller game, and a snare set overnight catches enough for one day's food on a successful DC 10 Survival check.

recipe.lore: Tail-hair is stronger than thread, nearly invisible in grass and doesn't smell of people, which is why every poacher begs hair from the stable.

items.name: Sinew-Backed Warbow
items.effect: A longbow backed with layers of glued animal sinew. It functions as a longbow, but a wielder with Strength 15 or higher increases its normal and long range by 30 and 100 feet.

components.label: Horn or antler for the nocks

recipe.lore: Sinew stretches and snaps back harder than wood, and a stubborn mule's tendons are said to be the most stubborn of all.

items.name: Antlerbone Skinning Knife
items.effect: A curved, razor-thin blade with an antler grip that never slips in bloody hands. Harvesting a hide, pelt or scales with it takes half the usual time, and it can be used as a dagger.

recipe.lore: Antler roughens when wet instead of turning slick, so skinners have hafted their best knives in it since before iron.

items.name: Sharktooth Arrows
items.effect: Arrows tipped with serrated shark teeth. On a critical hit, the target takes an extra 1d4 piercing damage as the serrations tear free.

recipe.lore: Sharks shed teeth all their lives and every one is a ready-made broadhead; pitch holds them better than any lashing.

items.name: Hollowfang Blowgun Needles
items.effect: Blowgun needles made from hollow beast fangs. Each fang holds one dose of injury poison in its channel, so coating a needle takes a bonus action instead of an action.

recipe.lore: Fangs grow around a channel for venom or blood; a drop of wax plugs the tip until the needle strikes.

items.name: Chitin Lamellar
items.effect: Overlapping plates of giant-insect shell laced onto a leather backing. It counts as scale mail but weighs 25 pounds and never rusts; it still imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks from its clacking.

recipe.lore: Chitin is as hard as bronze and half the weight; desert armourers simply replace every steel scale with a scrap of shell.

items.name: Tunneler's Mandible Pick
items.effect: A mining pick whose head is a burrowing monster's mandible or beak. It digs through earth and loose rock twice as fast as an ordinary pick and can be used as a war pick.

recipe.lore: Ankhegs and gricks chew through stone for a living; their mouthparts are simply better picks than anything a smith can forge.

items.name: Goathorn Crampons
items.effect: Straps of horn spikes that buckle over boots. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb ice and steep rock and on checks to avoid slipping on ice.

recipe.lore: Mountain goats walk up cliffs on hooves that are half horn; mountaineers borrow the principle a spike at a time.

items.name: Quipperscale Fishing Lure
items.effect: A spinner of flashing fish scales hung with tooth hooks. You have advantage on checks to catch fish, and a successful DC 10 Survival check with an hour's fishing feeds two people.

recipe.lore: Nothing draws a predator fish like the flash of another predator's scales.

items.name: Guano Cavefire Tinder
items.effect: Pellets of dried bat guano and saltpeter wrapped in waxed paper. A pellet lights with one strike even when wet, burns hot for a minute and reliably starts a fire in damp wood.

recipe.lore: Miners learned that the guano heaps in bat caves burn fiercely; mixed with saltpeter they make tinder that laughs at rain.

items.name: Constrictor Lasso
items.effect: A 30-foot lasso of braided snake muscle and skin that tightens when pulled. A creature caught in it has the grappled condition (escape DC 12) and it can be used as a net against a single Medium or smaller target.

recipe.lore: A constrictor's coils only ever tighten, and the braided muscle keeps that habit after tanning.

items.name: Hippogriff Riding Harness
items.effect: A saddle and chest-harness cut to sit behind a flier's wings. A rider using it has advantage on checks and saves to stay mounted on a flying creature.

recipe.lore: Leather taken from a flier stretches the way a flier moves, so a harness of hippogriff hide never pinches the wings it rides over.

items.name: Merrow Barbed Harpoon
items.effect: A heavy harpoon with a merrow's tusk as its barb and a 50-foot line. It functions as a spear; when it hits a Large or smaller creature, the target can't move farther from you than the line allows until it or you use an action to pull it free.

recipe.lore: Merrow use their own shed tusks for barbs; a harpoon they built for drowning sailors serves just as well for drowning them.

items.name: Lodestar Quill
items.effect: A long flight feather with a quicksilver-filled shaft. Dropped from any height, it always drifts down to point its tip toward magnetic north, even in a windless cave or underwater.

recipe.lore: Hawks and eagles never lose their way home; fill a hollow shaft with quicksilver and the feather keeps trying to fly there.

items.name: Emberscale Handwarmer
items.effect: A palm-sized pouch holding a single warm dragon scale. While you carry it you are comfortable in temperatures as low as 0 degrees Fahrenheit, and you can use it to dry a set of clothes in 10 minutes. It grants no protection from fire.

recipe.lore: Fire-dragon scales hold the heat of the furnace that grew them for decades. Wrapped in wool, one scale warms a traveller all winter.

items.name: Rimescale Cooling Locket
items.effect: A locket holding a flake of frost-dragon scale that is always cool to the touch. While you wear it you are comfortable in temperatures up to 120 degrees Fahrenheit, and water in a flask you hold against it chills in a minute.

recipe.lore: Desert jewellers pay well for the scales of frost wyrmlings; the chill never quite leaves them, and silver carries it to the skin.

items.name: Wyrmscale Ward-Charm
items.effect: A wyrmling scale drilled and hung on a cord. Once per day, when you take damage of the scale's type (acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison), you can reduce that damage by 1d6.

recipe.lore: A young dragon's scale already shrugs off its parent's breath; worn over the heart, it shrugs off a little for you too.

items.name: Wyrmling Soul-Bead
items.effect: A glass bead with a tiny swirling light inside. While you wear it you can speak and understand Draconic, and once per day you can ask it the direction of the nearest true dragon within 1 mile.

recipe.lore: A wyrmling's spark is mostly language and longing; sealed in glass it chatters in Draconic and pines for its kin.

items.name: Carrion-Seeker's Plume
items.effect: A bundle of black vulture feathers bound around a dried eye. Hung from a staff, it sways toward the nearest dead creature of Medium size or larger within 1 mile, and droops when a creature within 30 feet drops to 0 hit points.

recipe.lore: Vultures find the dead from miles away and gather before the dying are done; their eyes never forget the knack.

items.name: Jackal-Ear Earring
items.effect: A tiny cured ear pinned to a copper hoop. While you wear it and sleep, you wake instantly if a creature larger than Tiny moves within 30 feet of you.

recipe.lore: Jackals sleep with one ear up; caravan guards wear one of theirs for the same reason.

items.name: Echo-Bat Whistle
items.effect: A whistle of thin wing-bone that gives an inaudible shriek. As an action you blow it and learn the rough shape of walls, drops and large objects within 15 feet of you, even in total darkness, until the start of your next turn.

recipe.lore: Bats see with their voices; carve a whistle from their wing-struts and it hears its own echo for you.

items.name: Rattooth Gnawing Charm
items.effect: A yellow incisor on a string. Pressed against rope, leather or wood and left for 1 minute, it gnaws through up to an inch of the material, quietly and without help.

recipe.lore: A rat's incisors never stop growing and never stop wanting to gnaw. Dipped in rat blood, a pulled tooth still feels the itch.

items.name: Owlfeather Hush-Talon
items.effect: An owl talon hung on a downy cord. Once per day as a bonus action, you can make your footsteps silent for 10 minutes; this doesn't hide any other sounds you make.

recipe.lore: An owl drops on its prey without a sound. Hunters tie on its talon to borrow a little of that hush.

items.name: Wolf-Spider Dusk Lenses
items.effect: Goggles set with polished spider eyes. While you wear them you see in dim light within 30 feet as if it were bright light. They do nothing in total darkness.

recipe.lore: Wolf spiders hunt at dusk by eyesight alone; set in goggles, their eyes keep gathering the last of the light.

items.name: Tigerwhisker Draught-Charm
items.effect: Three stiff whiskers bound with gold wire. While you wear it, you can't be surprised by a creature that moves within 5 feet of you in darkness, because the whiskers bristle at the draught it makes.

recipe.lore: A tiger feels its way through the black jungle by its whiskers; they keep twitching long after the tiger is gone.

items.name: Snakeskin Grip-Wrap
items.effect: A strip of snakeskin wound around a weapon's grip. The wrapped weapon can't slip from your hand accidentally, and you have advantage on checks and saves to avoid being disarmed.

recipe.lore: Constrictors hold on by their scales as much as their muscle; wrap the skin on backwards and it clings to your palm the same way.

items.name: Octopus-Skin Tarp
items.effect: A 10-foot-square sheet of rubbery skin that slowly takes on the colour and texture of whatever it lies on. After 1 minute in place, checks to notice the tarp or anything under it are made with disadvantage.

recipe.lore: An octopus's skin changes colour on its own for a while after the animal dies. Stretched over canvas and fed brine, it never quite stops.

items.name: Suckergrip Gloves
items.effect: Gloves lined with tiny suckers. You have advantage on checks to hold onto slippery or wet things and to climb wet rock, ship hulls or ice.

recipe.lore: A single octopus arm has hundreds of suckers. Sliced thin and sewn into gloves, they keep gripping whatever they touch.

items.name: Tidewriter's Beak-Pen
items.effect: A pen with a nib of octopus beak. Anything written with it is invisible until the page is soaked in water, and fades again as the page dries.

recipe.lore: Octopuses are the sea's great tricksters, and their ink is made to vanish; smugglers' clerks carry pens with an octopus beak for a nib.

items.name: Bloodscent Shark Charm
items.effect: A shark's blood-sensing organ, dried and set behind a tooth. While you are in water, you know the direction of any bleeding creature within 300 feet.

recipe.lore: A shark can taste one drop of blood a mile off. Pearl divers wear this charm to know when to leave the water.

items.name: Hunter's Fang Trophy Torc
items.effect: A torc hung with the teeth or claws of a great predator you killed. Once per day, you have advantage on a Charisma (Intimidation) check against a beast, and beasts of the trophy's kind hesitate before attacking you.

recipe.requires: The keystone must come from a creature you helped kill.
recipe.lore: Beasts know the smell of an apex hunter that has been beaten. Wearing its teeth tells every animal in the forest who beat it.

items.name: Last-Stand Boar Tusk
items.effect: A curved tusk hung on a thong. When you take 5 or less damage that would drop you to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 hit point instead. The tusk then cracks and becomes an ordinary trophy.

recipe.lore: A wounded boar keeps charging long after it should be dead. Old hunters say the tusk remembers that last charge and gives it to you, once.

items.name: Ursine Climbing Claws
items.effect: Leather bands set with bear claws that strap over hands and boots. You can climb trees, packed ice and rough stone without a climber's kit, and you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb them.

recipe.lore: Black bears climb trees as easily as squirrels and polar bears scale ice floes; strap on their claws and you keep a little of the knack.

items.name: Burrower's Digging Gloves
items.effect: Heavy gloves tipped with badger claws. You can dig through loose earth or sand with your hands as fast as with a shovel, and your hands never blister.

recipe.lore: A badger can dig itself out of sight faster than a man can dig a grave; its claws never lose their appetite for soil.

items.name: Muskmask Trail-Wash
items.effect: A pungent wash rubbed onto skin and clothes. For 8 hours, creatures tracking you by scent have disadvantage on the check, and beasts that rely on smell take you for another animal.

recipe.lore: Weasels and badgers hide their own trail by stinking up everything around it. Poachers smear the same musk on their boots before walking a keeper's hounds' ground.

items.name: Direnose Tracking Snuff
items.effect: A pinch of dark powder snorted up the nose. For 1 hour, you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track by scent and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

recipe.lore: A dire wolf can follow a day-old trail across a river; dried and powdered, its snout lends that nose to a ranger for an hour.

items.name: Stagheart Tonic
items.effect: A red, bitter drink that sets the pulse racing. For 1 hour your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and you can take the Dash action as a bonus action once.

recipe.lore: The heart of a giant elk pounds through a whole day's chase. Rangers add antler velvet 'so the legs know where to go'.

items.name: Tigerbone Wine
items.effect: Strong rice wine steeped for weeks with ground tiger bone. For 1 hour after drinking, you have advantage on Strength checks (not attack rolls) and on Constitution saving throws against pain-causing effects.

recipe.lore: Grandmothers across the eastern hills swear by tiger-bone wine for aching joints; alchemists grudgingly admit the old women are right.

items.name: Lizardtail Regrowth Poultice
items.effect: A green paste wrapped in a leaf and bound over a wound. When you spend Hit Dice during a short rest with the poultice applied, the first die you spend is treated as if it rolled its maximum. It also stops bleeding and stabilises a dying creature.

recipe.lore: A lizard grows back its tail; a lemure grows back everything. Mixed with a centaur healer's herbs, their flesh teaches a wound how to close.

items.name: Cackle Pod
items.effect: A clay ball filled with hyena gland-paste that bursts on impact. Each creature within 10 feet of the impact point must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom save or be doubled over with laughter, taking disadvantage on its next attack roll.

recipe.lore: A hyena's laugh is a sickness of the throat; the gland that makes it bursts into a vapour that sets anyone who breathes it giggling.

items.name: Mimic-Call Lure
items.effect: A reed caller set with a dried hyena larynx. After hearing a voice or animal call for at least a minute, you can use it to reproduce that sound perfectly for up to 6 seconds at a time; a DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check reveals the trick.

recipe.lore: Giant hyenas lure travellers by crying like lost children. Hunters turn the same trick on the game they're after.

items.name: Crowsnest Raven's-Eye Bead
items.effect: A glossy black bead that was once a raven's eye. Once per day, you can gaze into it to recall perfectly a face, map or page of writing you have seen within the last week.

recipe.lore: Ravens remember every face that ever wronged them; their eyes keep the habit of remembering.

items.name: Twinskull Watch-Totem
items.effect: A two-headed dog skull on a short stake. Planted in the ground, it chatters its teeth whenever a creature larger than Tiny comes within 30 feet, for up to 8 hours. You can name up to six creatures it ignores.

recipe.lore: A death dog's two heads keep watch in turns, one always awake. Staked out at the edge of camp, the skull keeps up the habit.

items.name: Worgpelt Pack-Hood
items.effect: A hood made from a worg's head and ruff. You have advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks with wolves, dogs and other canines, who tend to treat you as a pack elder.

recipe.lore: Worgs rule wolf packs by fear; any wolf that smells worg on you bows first and asks questions later.

items.name: Mimic's Counterfeit Coffer
items.effect: A small wooden box lined with mimic flesh. On command it takes on the appearance of any ordinary object of its size, such as a book or loaf. Anyone but you who opens it is bitten for 1 piercing damage.

recipe.lore: A mimic's hunger is mostly a talent for pretending. Bottle a little of it in a box, add teeth, and you have the most honest lie a thief ever carried.

items.name: Rustgut Solvent
items.effect: A reddish slurry that eats iron. Poured on a nonmagical ferrous object no larger than a 1-foot cube, such as a lock, hinge or chain link, it corrodes the object to flaking rust over 1 minute.

recipe.lore: A rust monster digests iron with its stomach juices; bottled with vinegar, those juices keep hungrily working on locks and chains.

items.name: Rustward Lacquer
items.effect: A dull, pearly varnish made from powdered rust-monster shell. A coated weapon or suit of armor can't rust or corrode for a year, and a rust monster's touch doesn't affect it the first time.

recipe.lore: The only metal a rust monster can't eat is its own shell. Armourers learned to grind it into a lacquer that shows the beast what it can't have.

items.name: Cockatrice-Egg Grenade
items.effect: A blown cockatrice egg filled with its own clotted yolk. Thrown up to 30 feet, it bursts; a creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or be restrained until the end of its next turn as its limbs stiffen.

recipe.lore: Cockatrice yolk stiffens flesh like cold stone for a few moments. Bursting eggs make hunters of the brave and statues of the clumsy.

items.name: Stillstone Varnish
items.effect: A grey oil that turns an unattended nonmagical wooden, cloth or leather object no larger than a 1-foot cube into stone for 1 hour. Doors can be braced with it, rope stiffened into a bar, a cloak made into a bowl.

recipe.lore: A cockatrice's spark only turns things half to stone and only for a while; limestone and feather help it finish the job on things that aren't alive.

items.name: Gibbering Jar
items.effect: A clay pot filled with gibbering flesh that shrieks nonsense when broken. Each creature within 10 feet that can hear must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom save or be unable to take reactions until the end of its next turn.

recipe.lore: Mouther flesh keeps babbling long after the mouther is dead. Potters seal it in a jar where it grows louder and louder, waiting to be let out.

items.name: Ettercap Webline Net
items.effect: A net woven from ettercap silk that stays sticky for years. A creature restrained by it needs a DC 13 Strength check to escape, and cutting it requires 10 slashing damage to one strand.

recipe.lore: Ettercap silk is coarser than a spider's but far stickier. A pinch of the venom keeps the glue fresh.

items.name: Warmshadow Panther Mantle
items.effect: A short shoulder cape of black panther fur or darkmantle hide. In dim light or darkness it makes your outline hard to pick out: you can try to hide from creatures that see in darkness even if only lightly obscured.

components.label: Panther claw clasp or weasel trim

recipe.lore: Panther fur drinks lamplight, and darkmantle hide swallows what's left. Stitched together they make a cape even darkvision slides off.

items.name: Packmule Harness
items.effect: A harness hung with hoof charms. A beast of burden wearing it carries one and a half times its normal load without slowing and never gets exhausted from a forced march of 10 hours or less.

recipe.lore: Mules are too stubborn to know when they're tired. Hang a mule's hooves from any pack animal's harness and it catches the same stubbornness.

items.name: Windmane Bridle
items.effect: A bridle braided with white winged-horse mane. A mount wearing it jumps twice as far and high as normal and takes no damage from falling 20 feet or less.

recipe.lore: A pegasus's spark wants to rise; braided into a bridle with its own mane, it gives any horse a moment of lift.

items.name: Spritewing Hairpin
items.effect: A pin set with a pair of iridescent sprite wings. When you fall, you can use your reaction to make the wings flutter, slowing your descent to 60 feet per round for up to 1 minute. Usable once per day.

recipe.lore: Sprite wings still beat faintly after death; set in silver, they catch the air for you when you need it most.

items.name: Satyrfleece Wineskin
items.effect: A wineskin lined with curly satyr fleece. Water poured into it turns into passable wine after an hour, and anyone who drinks from it has advantage on the next saving throw against being charmed that they make within 1 hour.

recipe.lore: Satyrs drink more than anyone and are never led astray by it. Their fleece keeps that immunity close to the wine.

items.name: Dreadmirror Locket
items.effect: A locket holding a sea hag's milky eye. When you snap it open at someone, the eye shows them what they fear most for a moment. Once per day, you have advantage on a Charisma (Intimidation) check against a creature that sees it.

recipe.lore: A sea hag's glance can stop a heart with fright; dead, her eye only shows the fear and leaves the heart alone.

items.name: Haggard Glamour Powder
items.effect: A shimmering green face-powder. Dusted on, it changes one feature of your appearance, such as hair colour, a scar or wrinkles, for 8 hours. It can't change your size or shape.

recipe.lore: Sea hags spend their magic hiding their faces; ground with their scales, a hag's spark is only ever good for cosmetics.

items.name: Imp-Tongue Lozenge
items.effect: A sticky red sweet that tastes of sulphur. For 1 hour after you suck it, you can speak and understand Infernal and Abyssal, and you have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks against fiends.

recipe.lore: An imp's tongue is made for lying to devils. Candied, it lends that talent to whoever is desperate enough to suck on it.

items.name: Impish Vanishing Powder
items.effect: A pinch of powder thrown over yourself. You become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you move, attack or cast a spell.

recipe.lore: Imps and quasits flicker out of sight when frightened. A little of their spark still flinches away from any eye that looks at you.

items.name: Dretch Stinkpot
items.effect: A sealed clay pot of rotting dretch fluids. When shattered, it releases a 10-foot-radius cloud of stench for 1 minute; a creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

recipe.lore: A dretch's reek is its only weapon worth the name. Sealed in clay, it's more dangerous than the dretch ever was.

items.name: Polar-Liver Toxin
items.effect: A dried, powdered bear liver that is deadly when eaten. A creature that ingests it must make a DC 12 Constitution save, taking 3d6 poison damage and being poisoned for 8 hours on a failure, or half damage on a success.

recipe.lore: Northern hunters learn young never to eat a white bear's liver; poisoners learn it later and more profitably.

items.name: Stingblood Paste
items.effect: A burning paste of insect and scorpion venoms. A creature hit by a coated weapon or piece of ammunition must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or take an extra 2d4 poison damage. The coating lasts 1 minute.

recipe.lore: Wasps and scorpions sting to hurt; spiders bite to weaken. Mixed, the venoms do both.

items.name: Viper's Kiss Venom
items.effect: A clear snake venom concentrated by slow heating. A creature hit by a coated weapon must make a DC 12 Constitution save, taking 2d6 poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

recipe.lore: Snake venom is stronger once some of its water has been boiled away; poisoners crack the fang in too, to keep the venom's bite.

items.name: Crawler's Numbing Toxin
items.effect: A yellow oil milked from centipede fangs. A creature hit by a coated weapon must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute, and its speed is halved while poisoned this way.

recipe.lore: Centipedes numb before they eat; hunters use the same numbness to slow a fleeing buck or bandit.

items.name: Sewerfever Blade Paste
items.effect: A foul grey smear of plague blood and rabid froth. A creature hit by a coated weapon must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or become feverish, having disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks for 24 hours.

recipe.lore: Diseased rats and death dogs carry sickness in every drop they shed; ground with an unclean tooth, it clings to steel.

items.name: Drowse-Needle Venom
items.effect: A milky drug from a pseudodragon's tail or a young brass dragon's sleep gland. A creature hit by a coated weapon must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 hour; if it fails by 5 or more, it falls asleep for the duration or until it takes damage.

recipe.lore: Pseudodragons and brass wyrmlings both prefer their enemies napping; their venoms are the same stuff at different strengths.

items.name: Purging Toadsweat Draught
items.effect: A vile green emetic. Drinking it makes you retch for a round, then ends the poisoned condition on you and gives you advantage on saves against ingested poisons for 1 hour.

recipe.lore: A toad's skin-poison makes predators spit it out. A careful dose does the same for whatever else you swallowed.

items.name: Tarrying Copper Powder
items.effect: A glittering greenish dust thrown in a creature's face (range 10 feet). The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or have its speed halved and be unable to take reactions until the end of its next turn.

recipe.lore: Copper dragons slow their foes to laugh at them. A wyrmling's gland, dried with its own scales, keeps the joke going.

items.name: Stillbreath Vial
items.effect: A frost-rimed vial that shatters into a puff of numbing mist. Thrown up to 20 feet, a creature within 5 feet of the impact must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or have a speed of 0 until the end of its next turn.

recipe.lore: A silver wyrmling's second breath freezes muscles rather than flesh; chilling it with frost-dragon gland keeps it potent in the bottle.

items.name: Wyrmling Breath Bomb
items.effect: A thick glass flask holding a wyrmling's breath gland in brine. Thrown up to 20 feet, it bursts in a 5-foot radius; each creature there makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 2d6 damage of the gland's type (acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison) on a failure or half on a success.

recipe.lore: A wyrmling's breath gland still holds one puff when cut free; brine keeps it from going off in your pack.

items.name: Greenscale Filter Mask
items.effect: A cloth mask faced with overlapping green wyrmling scales. While you wear it you have advantage on saving throws against inhaled poisons and gases, and ordinary smoke doesn't make you cough.

recipe.lore: Green dragons breathe clouds of poison that never harm their own lungs; a wyrmling's scales keep that clean air around your face.

items.name: Coppergrip Climbing Gloves
items.effect: Fingerless gloves stitched with copper-scale pads. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb, and you can climb sheer stone slowly (half speed) without a kit.

recipe.lore: Copper dragons scramble up cliffs just for the joke of it; a wyrmling's spark lends that carefree grip.

items.name: Bronzefin Swim-Charm
items.effect: A bronze fin-shaped charm with a bit of a young dragon's spark in it. While you wear it, you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to swim, and you can hold your breath twice as long.

recipe.lore: Bronze and black dragons swim before they fly. Sailors wear a wyrmling's spark in bronze to be sure they swim better than they drown.

items.name: Merrowscale Swim-Fins
items.effect: Webbed fins of overlapping scales that strap to your feet. You don't need to spend extra movement to swim, but your walking speed is reduced by 10 feet while wearing them on land.

recipe.lore: Merrow scales ripple the water behind them like a fish's tail; sewn into fins, they pull you along the same way.

items.name: Sharkliver Swim-Grease
items.effect: A pungent grease rubbed over the body. For 1 hour you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to swim and you don't suffer exhaustion from cold water.

recipe.lore: Shark-liver oil never freezes and makes skin slick as a fish; bear fat thickens it so it stays on.

items.name: Pseudodragon Whisper-Earring
items.effect: A small bright scale hung from the ear. Once per day, as an action, you can sense whether magic is present within 10 feet of you, and you learn which object or creature carries it.

recipe.lore: Pseudodragons sniff out spellcraft for the mages they choose to serve; a little of their spark remembers how.

items.name: Harpy-Song Chime
items.effect: A chime of hollow talons that sings a haunting note. Once per day you can ring it to draw curious beasts and birds within a quarter mile toward you for 10 minutes; hostile creatures aren't affected.

recipe.lore: Harpies sing to lure the curious; a trapper strings their talons into a chime that sings only to animals.

items.name: Stoneward Basilisk Balm
items.effect: A grey-green salve that smells of wet stone. Rubbed on a creature that is restrained or slowed by a petrifying effect, it ends that effect; for 1 hour afterward the creature has advantage on saving throws against being petrified.

recipe.lore: A basilisk's blood keeps its own flesh from turning to stone under its gaze. Folk healers learned it does the same for anyone else, provided you catch the stiffening early.

items.name: Gorgon-Breath Flask
items.effect: A heavy iron flask sealing a gorgon's breath gland. Opened as an action, it jets a 15-foot cone of green vapour; each creature in it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or be restrained, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the effect on a success. A creature that fails three times is petrified for 1 minute. Single use.

recipe.lore: A gorgon's breath is carried in a gland of iron-hard tissue that needs an iron flask to hold it; a cockatrice's spark keeps the vapour from souring.

items.name: Juggernaut Hide Armor
items.effect: Hide armor built around panels of near-impenetrable monster hide. While you wear it, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

recipe.lore: Some hides simply don't have a weak spot; arrows and blades that should find the gap in the armour find only more hide. Elephant-bone stays hold the panels flat.

items.name: Frillguard Shield
items.effect: A shield carved from a triceratops frill. When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your proficiency bonus.

recipe.lore: A triceratops herd faces danger in a ring, frills overlapping. Carved into a shield, the frill still wants to guard the calf beside it.

items.name: Stampede Horn Helm
items.effect: A heavy helm mounted with a great horn. Once per turn, if you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hit it with a melee attack on the same turn, it takes an extra 1d8 piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be knocked prone.

recipe.lore: Triceratops and rhinos don't aim, they commit. A helm topped with their horn teaches the wearer the same charge.

items.name: Apeskull War-Helm
items.effect: A helm made from the skull of a giant ape. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you roar and beat your chest; each creature of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

recipe.lore: A giant ape rules its mountain by display alone; wearing its skull, even a halfling gets a fair share of the effect.

items.name: Manticore Quill Bolts
items.effect: Crossbow bolts made from manticore tail spikes. You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with them, and a creature hit takes an extra 1d4 piercing damage from the splintering barbs.

recipe.lore: A manticore flings its spikes at prey; they are already shaped to fly. A bowyer only has to add a nock.

items.name: Roaring Mane Mantle
items.effect: A shaggy shoulder-mantle of a monstrous lion's mane. Once per long rest, as an action, you roar; each creature of your choice within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened of you for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

recipe.lore: A manticore's mane rises before it roars; tanned and worn, it still bristles when its wearer shouts.

items.name: Draught of the Three Beasts
items.effect: A smoking, three-layered potion. For 10 minutes, you choose one gift when you drink it: the lion's roar (advantage on Intimidation and Strength checks), the goat's hooves (you can't be knocked prone and ignore difficult terrain from rubble) or the dragon's hide (resistance to fire damage).

recipe.lore: A chimera's spark is three animals quarrelling; alchemists decant it so that only one wins at a time.

items.name: Hexclaw Gloves
items.effect: Gloves tipped with long curved nails. Once per long rest, when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or a melee weapon attack, you can curse it: for 1 minute it has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and saving throws.

recipe.lore: A lamia's touch clouds the mind and a green hag's scratch leaves doubts behind. Worn on your hands, they leave the same dull mark.

items.name: Hagtongue Mimic-Reed
items.effect: A reed pipe with a hag's tongue curled inside. As an action you can speak through it and throw your voice to any point within 60 feet, or perfectly imitate any voice you have heard, for up to 1 minute. A creature that hears it and succeeds on a DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check notices the fraud.

recipe.lore: Green hags lure travellers with the voices of lost loved ones; their tongues keep the trick even after the hag has stopped talking.

items.name: Moonhorn Mending Salve
items.effect: A faintly glowing silver salve. Applied as an action, it restores 4d4 + 4 hit points and ends one disease or the poisoned condition on the creature.

recipe.requires: The essence must be willingly given or taken from a unicorn that died by misfortune, never by murder.
recipe.lore: A unicorn's spark heals whatever it touches, and a centaur healer's herb-lore gives it something to hold on to.

items.name: Griffon-Yolk Tonic
items.effect: A rich golden drink whipped from a griffon egg. For 1 hour you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, your jump distance triples, and you take no damage from falling.

recipe.requires: Only a fertile, unhatched egg works; hatchery owners will not sell them lightly.
recipe.lore: Griffon chicks leap from mountain nests before they can fly and land unharmed. The yolk carries the knack for a while.

items.name: Pinion Glide-Cloak
items.effect: A cloak with ribbed wing-panels sewn into the sleeves. When you fall and aren't incapacitated, you can spread your arms to glide, moving up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot you descend, and you take no falling damage.

recipe.lore: Only a large wing can carry a person's weight, and fiendish wings are the ones hunters most often bring home. Griffon and vulture feathers trim the edges so the glide stays steady.

items.name: Frostbite Fang Dagger
items.effect: A dagger whose blade is a winter wolf's fang, always rimed with frost. A creature hit takes an extra 1d6 cold damage, and once per turn a hit reduces its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

recipe.lore: A winter wolf's bite freezes the blood in the wound. The fang doesn't forget, especially when set in a hilt of frost-dragon scale.

items.name: Hellhound Ember Arrows
items.effect: Arrows tipped with slivers of hell hound fang that glow like coals. A creature hit takes an extra 1d6 fire damage, and the arrow ignites flammable objects it strikes.

recipe.lore: Hell hounds breathe fire through their teeth; cut into arrowheads, each fang-sliver keeps a coal alive inside it.

items.name: Ashwalker Boots
items.effect: Boots of charred black hide. You can walk on hot coals, cooling lava crust and burning floors without harm, and you have advantage on saving throws against being set on fire.

recipe.lore: A nightmare's hooves leave burning prints, yet its own hide never scorches. Soled with fire-dragon scale, the boots walk where it walks.

items.name: Devilhide Barbed Jerkin
items.effect: Studded leather made from barbed devil hide, bristling with spines. A creature that grapples you or that you grapple takes 1d6 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns while the grapple lasts.

recipe.lore: Barbed devils fight by hugging their enemies to death; their skin is a weapon, and it keeps being one on your back.

items.name: Hellsworn Courage Talisman
items.effect: An iron token that has drunk devil ichor. While you wear it you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened, and once per day you can end the frightened condition on yourself as a bonus action.

recipe.lore: Devils are taught to fear only their superiors. A bearded devil's spark bound in iron is too proud to fear anything less than a pit fiend.

items.name: Hellbeard Venom
items.effect: A sticky black venom milked from a devil's beard tendrils. A creature hit by a coated weapon must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or take 3d6 poison damage and be unable to regain hit points for 1 minute.

recipe.lore: The tendrils of a bearded devil's beard keep a wound from healing; mixed with lesser fiends' poisons, the venom keeps its grudge.

items.name: Vrock Screech-Horn
items.effect: A horn that gives a demon-bird's screech. Once per long rest, as an action, you blow it; each creature within 20 feet that can hear must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or be deafened and unable to take reactions until the end of your next turn.

recipe.lore: A vrock's screech stuns even demons. Its spark bound in a horn is louder than any bugle and far less pleasant.

items.name: Dreamwarden Snare
items.effect: A hoop of black thread woven with a hag's own hair. While it hangs within 10 feet of you, you can't be targeted by dream-intruding magic while you sleep, and you have advantage on saves against magical sleep.

recipe.lore: Night hags ride the dreams of the sleeping; catching one's spark in a snare builds a wall of her own making around your head.

items.name: Owlbear Crush-Pick
items.effect: A war pick whose head is a hooked owlbear beak. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and when you score a critical hit the target is grappled by the beak's hook (escape DC 13).

recipe.lore: An owlbear doesn't let go once it has bitten; its beak on a haft keeps the grudge.

items.name: Pincer Grapple-Gauntlet
items.effect: An armored gauntlet ending in a crustacean pincer. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike using it, you can attempt to grapple it as a bonus action, and you have advantage on checks to keep a creature grappled.

recipe.lore: Chuuls and giant scorpions catch and hold before they kill. The pincer's grip is in the tendons, and they come with the claw.

items.name: Otyugh Sewer-Waders
items.effect: Chest-high waders of warty otyugh hide. While you wear them, you can't catch diseases from filth, carrion or sewer water, and you have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned by rot and stench.

recipe.lore: Otyughs wallow in filth that would kill anything else. Their hide is the reason.

items.name: Roperhide Cave-Cloak
items.effect: A stiff grey cloak of roper skin. While you stand still in a cave or among rocks, you are indistinguishable from a stalagmite or boulder and have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.

recipe.lore: Ropers, gricks and darkmantles all hunt by pretending to be part of the cave; their hides remember the disguise.

items.name: Roper Lashing-Line
items.effect: A 50-foot grey cord weighted with roper gizzard stones. As an action you can hurl it at an object within 50 feet, where it lashes itself tight and holds up to 500 pounds. Once per short rest you can instead make a ranged weapon attack with it (proficiency applies) against a Large or smaller creature within 50 feet: on a hit it is restrained (escape DC 13) until it escapes or you release it.

recipe.lore: A roper's tendrils snap out and stick; its spark woven into a rope makes the rope want to do the same. The gizzard stones give it the weight to fly true.

items.name: Drider-Shell Cuirass
items.effect: A breastplate of glossy black drider chitin. While wearing it you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in darkness, and once per long rest you can gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed for 10 minutes, even on ceilings.

recipe.lore: Drider chitin is black as the Underdark and still remembers walking upside down.

items.name: Webwarden's Kris
items.effect: A wavy-bladed dagger reforged from a drider's poisoned blade. Its hollow fuller holds venom: a creature hit takes an extra 1d6 poison damage, and once per short rest you can force it to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of your next turn.

recipe.lore: The drider's blade was always a poisoned tool; ground back and rewrapped in ettercap silk soaked with spider venom, it carries poison on every cut.

items.name: Deepscent Shark Circlet
items.effect: A circlet of shark cartilage set with a dried snout. While submerged, you have blindsight to a range of 30 feet and automatically sense any creature below half its hit points within 120 feet.

recipe.lore: A giant shark feels the heartbeat of wounded prey through the water. Its snout keeps sensing long after the rest of it is soup.

items.name: Echomelon Diving Helm
items.effect: A leather helm padded with an orca's echo-melon. While you are underwater, you have blindsight to a range of 60 feet, and you can hear sounds from up to a mile away clearly.

recipe.lore: Orcas see with sound through the fatty melon in their foreheads. Worn over your own forehead, it clicks for you.

items.name: Crocheart Diving Elixir
items.effect: A murky green potion. For 1 hour you don't need to breathe while underwater, you gain a swimming speed of 30 feet, and you can see through murky water twice as far as normal.

recipe.lore: A giant crocodile can lie on the riverbed for an hour with its slow, stubborn heart. The elixir slows yours to match.

items.name: Snapjaw Trap
items.effect: A hunting trap set with the jaws of a giant crocodile. A creature that triggers it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 2d8 piercing damage and be restrained; escaping requires a DC 15 Strength check. It resets itself one minute after being opened.

recipe.lore: Giant crocodiles have the strongest bite of any beast; their teeth set in steel close even faster than the springs can pull.

items.name: Wyvernhide Riding Jerkin
items.effect: Studded leather cut from wyvern hide. While wearing it, you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you can't be knocked off a mount while you are conscious.

recipe.lore: Wyvern riders wear the hide of the beast for two reasons: its own venom can't get through it, and it grips a saddle like it wants to fly.

items.name: Stormsand Strider Boots
items.effect: Sand-coloured boots that crackle when they touch dunes. Sand and loose earth never count as difficult terrain for you, you can't sink in quicksand, and you have advantage on saves against sandstorms and lightning.

recipe.lore: Blue dragons swim through sand as though it were water; a wyrmling's spark keeps your feet on top of it.

items.name: Lullaby Brass Censer
items.effect: A brass censer that burns a young dragon's sleep gland with herbs. Once per long rest, as an action, you swing it to cast sleep (3rd-level version) centred on a point within 30 feet.

components.label: Young brass dragon sleep gland or essence

recipe.lore: A brass dragon's sleeping breath is sweet as incense. Burned in its own metal, the gland yields a slow smoke that lulls a room.

items.name: Wyrmfire Grenade
items.effect: A clay-sealed iron shell containing a dragon's breath gland. Thrown up to 40 feet, it erupts in a 10-foot radius; each creature there must make a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 4d6 damage of the gland's type (fire or cold) on a failure or half on a success.

components.label: Fire or frost dragon breath gland

recipe.lore: A dragon's breath gland is under pressure even in death; pack it in iron and seal the shell with clay and it goes off with a real dragon's temper.

items.name: Enfeebling Gilt Mist
items.effect: A golden gas in a thin glass sphere. Thrown up to 30 feet, it bursts in a 10-foot radius; each creature there must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, checks and saves for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

recipe.lore: Gold dragons would rather weaken an enemy than kill it; their gland makes muscles go soft as dough for a minute.

items.name: Deepmind Aboleth Circlet
items.effect: A circlet of pale, slime-slick coral. While you wear it you can communicate telepathically with any creature within 60 feet that knows a language, and once per long rest you can cast detect thoughts (save DC 15) from it.

recipe.lore: An aboleth thinks into other minds as easily as it breathes water. Its spark, soaked in its own slime, keeps reaching for thoughts.

items.name: Stormcoil Behir Javelin
items.effect: A javelin wrapped in a coiled blue behir scale. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and it deals an extra 1d6 lightning damage. Once per long rest, when you throw it, it becomes a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot line of lightning; each creature in the line must make a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 6d6 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. The javelin reappears in your hand.

recipe.lore: Behirs and blue dragons hate each other because they drink the same storms. Either's spark in a copper-wound shaft turns the javelin into lightning.

items.name: Remorhaz Heatplate
items.effect: A breastplate lined with the glowing back-plates of a remorhaz. You have resistance to cold damage and are comfortable in any cold climate, and a creature that hits you with a melee attack while within 5 feet of you takes 2d6 fire damage.

recipe.lore: A remorhaz burns so hot it melts tunnels through glaciers; its spark in steel keeps the wearer warm and anyone who touches them burned.

items.name: Rocbeak Maul
items.effect: A two-handed maul whose head is a roc's hooked beak. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it. Once per turn, when you hit a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

recipe.lore: A roc's beak snaps elephants in half. Hafted on elephant bone, it treats everything else the same way.

items.name: Coilheart Naga Amulet
items.effect: An amulet holding a spirit naga's dried heart in a cage of silver. Once per long rest, when you would drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 hit point instead and regain 2d10 hit points at the start of your next turn. You also have advantage on death saving throws.

recipe.lore: A spirit naga re-forms after death as long as its will endures. The heart keeps that will; it lends a little of it to you.

items.name: Pactbreaker's Ledger
items.effect: A slim book bound in fiend hide. A contract written in it and signed by two willing parties binds them: a signer who knowingly breaks its terms takes 5d10 psychic damage and is cursed with disadvantage on saving throws until they make amends. You also have advantage on checks to spot loopholes in any contract you read while holding it.

recipe.lore: Glabrezu grant wishes and write the fine print. Their essence, bound in their own hide with an imp's tongue for a bookmark, makes every contract a trap for the careless.

items.name: Toadfiend Stench Draught
items.effect: A bubbling, reeking potion. For 1 hour you are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition, and you exude a stench: any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

recipe.lore: A hezrou swims in its own poison without harm. Its spark does the same inside you, and the smell comes with it.

items.name: Bonedevil Ossuary Shield
items.effect: A shield of interlocking bone devil plates. While holding it you gain a +2 bonus to AC in addition to the shield's normal bonus, and you have resistance to poison damage.

recipe.lore: Bone devils are armoured in their own ribs, and the ribs are soaked in poison that never harms them.

items.name: Fury's Tears
items.effect: A dark red poison distilled from an erinyes' blood. A creature hit by a coated weapon must make a DC 16 Constitution save, taking 6d6 poison damage and being poisoned for 1 minute on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

recipe.lore: An erinyes' arrows are poisoned with her own blood; poisoners who can get it pay for it with their own nerves.

items.name: Hellhorn Fork
items.effect: A trident with a horned devil's horn for its central tine. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it and it deals an extra 1d6 fire damage. Once per long rest, you can hurl a ball of hellfire from its tines, casting fireball (save DC 15).

recipe.lore: Horned devils fight with forks and fling flame from their hands; the horn is where the flame starts.

items.name: Wyrmsoul Bracers
items.effect: Leather bracers sealing a young dragon's spark. While you wear them you have resistance to the damage type of that dragon's breath, and once per long rest you can speak a word to gain the dragon's gift for 10 minutes: black, swim speed 40 feet; blue, burrow speed 15 feet through sand; green, advantage on Deception; red, advantage on Intimidation; copper, climbing speed 30 feet; silver, walk on clouds and mist.

components.label: Young chromatic or metallic dragon essence

recipe.lore: A young dragon's soul still remembers its breath before anything else; strapped to your wrists it catches the same breath for you.

items.name: Dragonblood Tonic
items.effect: A thick, shimmering draught of fresh dragon blood. For 8 hours you have resistance to the damage type of the dragon's breath and advantage on Strength checks and saves.

recipe.lore: The old tales are true in part: bathe in dragon blood and you'll just be sticky, but drink it within the hour and you burn with the dragon's hardiness for a day.

items.name: Wyrmfang Blade
items.effect: A shortsword or dagger whose blade is ground from an adult dragon's fang. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and it deals an extra 1d6 damage of the dragon's breath type (acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison).

recipe.lore: Every bite an adult dragon ever took soaked its fangs with its breath; ground to an edge, the fang bites with that breath still.

items.name: Wyrmwing Cloak
items.effect: A heavy cloak cut from a single adult dragon's wing membrane, ribbed with thin wing bones. While wearing it you can use an action to spread it and gain a flying speed of 60 feet for up to 1 hour per long rest, spent in 1-minute increments.

recipe.lore: An adult dragon's wing is the largest single hide a hunter will ever skin, and it has never forgotten how to catch the wind.

items.name: Dragonbreath Draught
items.effect: A fiery potion made around a young dragon's breath gland. For 1 hour, you can use an action to exhale a 30-foot cone of the gland's damage type (acid, fire or poison); each creature in it must make a DC 15 Dexterity save (Constitution for poison), taking 6d6 damage on a failure or half on a success. You can do this three times before the potion wears off.

recipe.lore: A young dragon's breath gland holds three good exhalations when cut out cleanly. Distilled, it lets you spend them.

items.name: Gilded Enervation Oil
items.effect: A glittering gold oil for weapons. For 1 hour, a creature hit by the coated weapon must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, checks and saves until the end of its next turn, and its speed is halved.

recipe.lore: A gold dragon's weakening breath is gentle and merciless. On an edge it drains the fight from anyone it cuts.

items.name: Blackwater Mantle
items.effect: A glossy black cloak that sheds water like oil. While you wear it you can breathe water, you have a swimming speed of 40 feet, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in water or darkness.

recipe.lore: Black dragons lurk in swamps with only their eyes above the water; their spark wraps you in the same murk.

items.name: Turtleflipper Dive-Suit
items.effect: Supple leather armor cut from dragon turtle flippers. It counts as leather armor that grants a +1 bonus to AC, you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and you have resistance to cold damage and ignore the effects of deep-water pressure.

components.label: Water-proven hide (dragon turtle flipper, young bronze dragon scales or hydra scales)

recipe.lore: A dragon turtle's flippers push its bulk through the ocean like a warship's oars. Worn, the hide still wants to swim. A young bronze dragon's scales or a hydra's, both made for water, will do in place of dragon turtle flipper.

items.name: Wyrmgullet Elixir
items.effect: A scalding potion brewed from an adult dragon's breath gland. For 1 hour you can use an action to exhale a 60-foot cone (or 90-foot line for lightning) of the gland's damage type; each creature in it must make a DC 18 saving throw, taking 8d6 damage on a failure or half on a success. You can breathe three times before the elixir wears off.

recipe.lore: An adult dragon's breath gland is the size of a wine cask. It takes a month to boil it down to a single vial, and every alchemist who tries it loses their eyebrows.

items.name: Wyrmhorn War-Bugle
items.effect: A hollowed ancient dragon horn. Once per long rest, as an action, you blow it; each creature of your choice within 120 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom save or be frightened of you for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Allies within the same range gain 2d10 temporary hit points.

recipe.lore: An ancient dragon's presence alone breaks armies; its horn, hollowed and blown, is that presence given voice.

items.name: Wyrmcrest Helm
items.effect: A crested helm holding an adult dragon's spark. While you wear it you are immune to the damage type of that dragon's breath and have advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Once per long rest you can exhale a 60-foot cone of that damage type (DC 18, 10d6).

recipe.lore: A dragon's crest is where the old smiths believed its soul lived. Mount its spark there and the helm takes on the dragon's pride.

items.name: Copperheart Luckstone
items.effect: A lump of petrified dragon heart the colour of old pennies. While you carry it you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws, and three times per long rest you can reroll a d20 after seeing the result, keeping the new roll.

recipe.lore: Copper dragons live on luck and laughter; their hearts keep beating out a gambler's rhythm long after the dragon is dust.

items.name: Bronzeheart Tideguard
items.effect: An amulet of bronze wire wrapped around a dragon's dried heart. While wearing it you have a swimming speed of 60 feet, can breathe water, are immune to lightning damage, and your Strength score is 21 while you are in water.

components.label: Adult bronze dragon heart or essence

recipe.lore: Bronze dragons patrol the coasts and hurl ships ashore with their strength; their hearts keep that tide-strength close to your own.

items.name: Hourglass of Copper Sloth
items.effect: An hourglass filled with glittering copper dust. As an action you can turn it to cast slow (save DC 18); it has 3 charges and regains 1d3 charges each dawn.

recipe.lore: The copper dragon's slowing breath makes time feel thick; ground and poured into an hourglass, it makes the sand run slower for everyone.

items.name: Brass Wyrm's Slumber Bell
items.effect: A brass bell that rings with a drowsy hum. Once per long rest, as an action, you can ring it; each creature of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution save or fall unconscious for 10 minutes or until it takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it. Creatures immune to being charmed or that don't sleep are unaffected.

recipe.lore: Great brass dragons put whole caravans to sleep so they can chat to them later. Their gland, sealed in a bell, still hums them to sleep.

items.name: Sunwyrm Hex-Lantern
items.effect: A gilded lantern whose light makes enemies feeble. As an action you can unshutter it; each creature of your choice in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 18 Strength save or have disadvantage on Strength-based attacks, checks and saves for 1 minute (repeating the save each turn). Once per long rest.

recipe.lore: Gold dragons breathe weakness rather than death when they can; their gland's glow saps the arms of any foe it touches.

items.name: Tidefortress Shield
items.effect: A shield carved from a dragon turtle's shell plate, fringed with its beak. It grants a +2 bonus to AC in addition to the shield's normal bonus, and you have resistance to fire damage.

recipe.lore: A dragon turtle's shell turns aside its own scalding breath and every harpoon ever thrown at it.

items.name: Scalding Mist Censer
items.effect: A bronze censer that belches superheated steam. Once per long rest, as an action, you can fill a 20-foot-radius sphere within 60 feet with scalding fog for 1 minute; the area is heavily obscured, and each creature that starts its turn there must make a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 6d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.

recipe.lore: A dragon turtle boils the sea around it with one breath; a bronze censer keeps a fraction of that steam on hand.

items.name: Krakenhide Diving Suit
items.effect: A full suit of dark, rubbery kraken hide. It counts as leather armor that grants a +2 bonus to AC; you can breathe water, have a swimming speed of 60 feet, have resistance to cold and lightning damage, and are unaffected by the pressure of any ocean depth.

components.label: Deep-water hide (kraken hide, or scales of an adult bronze or black dragon)

recipe.lore: The kraken dives to depths that would crush a ship; its hide simply doesn't care about water. The scales of an adult bronze or black dragon, both at home under water, can be cut into a suit nearly as good.

items.name: Pitfiend Wingmantle
items.effect: A cloak of vast, leathery fiend wings. While wearing it you have a flying speed of 60 feet, and once per long rest you can spread the wings as an action; each creature of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom save or be frightened of you for 1 minute.

recipe.lore: Pit fiends and balors spread their wings to announce who rules. Worn, the wings still announce it.

items.name: Infernal Scaleplate
items.effect: Plate armor faced with blood-red pit fiend scales. It grants a +1 bonus to AC; you are immune to fire damage and have advantage on saving throws against spells. Its fang-tipped gauntlets add 1d6 poison damage to your unarmed strikes.

recipe.lore: A pit fiend's scales shrug off both flame and sorcery; its fangs are too good to waste on anything but the gauntlets.

items.name: Icejaw Spear
items.effect: A spear whose head is an ice devil's mandible. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and it deals an extra 1d6 cold damage. Once per turn, a creature you hit must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution save or be slowed (speed halved, no reactions) until the end of its next turn.

recipe.lore: An ice devil's bite freezes the blood mid-heartbeat. Its mandible set on a shaft keeps biting.

items.name: Nalfeshnee Tusk Cleaver
items.effect: A greataxe whose blade is a single enormous demon tusk. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and your Strength score is 19 while you wield it (if it isn't already higher). On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

recipe.lore: Nalfeshnees are all tusk and appetite. Boar tusks bind the handle, because the demon's own tusk dislikes being held by anything less.

items.name: Wyrmlord's Last Breath
items.effect: An ancient dragon's final breath, held in a crystal decanter. When you drink it, you can use an action within the next 10 minutes to exhale a 90-foot cone (or 120-foot line for lightning) of the gland's damage type; each creature in it must make a DC 21 saving throw, taking 16d6 damage on a failure or half on a success. For the same 10 minutes you are immune to that damage type.

recipe.lore: An ancient dragon's breath gland holds centuries of fury; distilled through quicksilver and diamond, a single mouthful carries all of it.

items.name: Wyrmseye Orb
items.effect: A fist-sized orb that was once an ancient dragon's eye. While attuned and holding it, you have truesight to 60 feet and blindsight to 30 feet, and once per long rest you can cast scrying (DC 21) through it without components.

recipe.lore: Ancient dragons have watched the world for a thousand years; their eyes see through lies, walls and distance, and a fused crystal keeps them looking.

items.name: Elder Wyrmheart Aegis
items.effect: A plate-sized amulet caging an ancient dragon's heart, which still beats slowly. While attuned, your hit point maximum increases by 20 and you are immune to the dragon's breath damage type and to the frightened condition. Once per long rest, when you drop to 0 hit points you instead drop to 1 and regain 4d10 hit points as the heart roars.

recipe.lore: An ancient dragon's heart never quite stops. Caged over your own, it lends its thousand-year stamina one beat at a time.

items.name: Ancient Wyrm Soulcrown
items.effect: A diamond-studded gold crown that houses an ancient dragon's soul. While attuned, you are immune to that dragon's breath type, you can speak with any dragon, and once per long rest you can cast the dragon's signature magic: black, insect plague; green, dominate person; white, ice storm; bronze, control water; silver, polymorph; copper, slow; gold, holy aura.

recipe.lore: An ancient dragon's soul is too proud to be held by anything but a crown, and too old to stay quiet in one.

items.name: Honeytongue Diadem
items.effect: A green-gold diadem with a dragon's forked tongue curled at its brow. While attuned, you have advantage on Charisma checks. It has 3 charges (regains all at dawn): spend 1 to cast suggestion, or all 3 to cast mass suggestion (save DC 21). Creatures charmed by you don't realise it afterward.

recipe.lore: An ancient green dragon talks kingdoms into ruin; its tongue keeps talking once it's gilded.

items.name: Rimeheart Glacier Staff
items.effect: A staff of blue-white ice around an ancient white dragon's frozen core. It never melts. While attuned, you are immune to cold damage. The staff has 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn): spend 4 to cast ice storm, 5 for cone of cold or 6 for wall of ice (save DC 21). Once per long rest you can instead cast cone of cold at 8th level without spending charges.

recipe.lore: An ancient white dragon's rime core is a glacier the size of a heart; set in wood, it never stops freezing the air around it.

items.name: Abyssal Deep-Eye
items.effect: A kraken's eye preserved in a globe of salt water. While attuned, you have darkvision and truesight to 120 feet, and once per long rest you can see through any body of salt water you name as if you were there, for up to 1 hour.

recipe.lore: The kraken watched its ocean from the darkest trench; its eye, kept wet, still sees every drop of it.

items.name: Sunwyrm's Radiant Seal
items.effect: A heavy gold signet stamped with a coiled dragon. While attuned, you are immune to fire damage, allies within 10 feet of you have advantage on saving throws, and once per long rest you can cast holy aura without components.

components.label: Ancient gold dragon essence or gland

recipe.lore: Ancient gold dragons are the closest thing to kings among dragons, and their blessing is as heavy as their gold.

items.name: Heartfire Tyrant Crown
items.effect: A crown forged around a shard of an ancient red dragon's heart. While attuned, you are immune to fire damage, your Strength becomes 25, and once per long rest you can exhale a 90-foot cone of fire (DC 21, 18d6).

recipe.lore: Red dragons are the strongest and angriest of their kind, and all of it lives in the heart.

items.name: Silverheart Guise Ring
items.effect: A silver ring holding a sliver of an ancient silver dragon's heart. While attuned, you can cast alter self at will and polymorph (self only) once per long rest, you are immune to cold damage, and you gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws.

components.label: Ancient silver dragon heart or essence

recipe.lore: Silver dragons spend centuries among mortals in disguise. Their hearts hold the secret of wearing another shape.
